statement: For every finite simple graph G, every subset K of its vertices, every integer n >= |K|, and every i >= 0, the integral homology group H_i(Sigma(G,K,n); Z) is free abelian, where Sigma is exactly the anchored configuration space of Definition 4.13 frozen in source.md. Consequently no cograph tuple (G,K,n,i) has nonzero integral homology torsion, so the frozen existential assertion is false.
contribution: A full-scope chain-level reduction: a cellular Cech resolution of the anchor-injection cover is replaced compatibly by the homology complex of G and then split by the coordinates carrying H_1(G). Each remaining compatibility nerve is identified with the cover nerve of an anchored tree space, whose homology is free by Kozlov's Theorem 2.5. The argument is stronger than the requested cograph statement and is accompanied by two independent exact chain implementations, integral Smith cases, and an exhaustive small-graph modular check. A bounded 2026-09-08 literature screen found no equivalent resolution, but this is not a claim of certified priority.
